title: Ballerina Trigger Metadata
description: Machine contract for a connector's resources/trigger-metadata.json: the authoring rules (presence, oneOf relationships, identifier semantics, non-concrete handler shapes) that sit above the syntax tree and semantic model and cannot be recovered by introspecting the library alone. See README.md/spec.md for the governing DRY principle and field-by-field rationale.

annotations.description: Prefer omitting the key entirely when the connector declares no annotations; an empty array is also accepted.

dataBindingRules.description: Prefer omitting the key entirely when the connector declares no data-binding rules; an empty array is also accepted.

typeRefOrUnion.description: A single TypeRef, or a JSON array of them for a union. Order matters: the first element is the codegen default when nothing else disambiguates.

form.description: Legal shapes for this slot, e.g. "basePath", "stringLiteral", "identifierSegment". More than one entry means either is syntactically valid.

values.description: The closed set of legal literal values for this slot, e.g. HTTP methods or a GraphQL accessor.

services.description: serviceTypes[].id values this listener can host.

concrete.description: true: the type declares its own methods directly (fully introspectable). false: marker/abstract type; handlers.options is the only source of truth.

identifier.description: Omit the whole key when the identifier slot carries no meaning for this service type.

backedByConcreteType.description: true: the service type's own declared methods are the handlers; options is empty/absent. false: options is the only source of truth.

addMode.description: subset: a fixed, named vocabulary, each option carrying its own presence. many: an open-ended, user-named set, represented as a single option named "*". Absent when backedByConcreteType is true.

name.description: The handler's method name, or "*" for an open/many-shaped handler.

annotations.description: Ids into the top-level annotations[] registry, attachPoint: "function".

method.description: Resource-kind extra (HTTP): the legal HTTP verbs.

path.description: Resource-kind extra (HTTP): the legal path-segment shapes.

fieldName.description: Resource-kind extra (GraphQL): the legal field-name shapes.

name.description: The conventional/domain-meaningful parameter name; omitted where the name carries no meaning beyond its position.

addMode.description: This slot can repeat zero or more times, each occurrence independently named/typed by the user. Absent means "at most one".

dataBinding.description: Id into the top-level dataBindingRules[] registry; present only when the raw value can be projected into a different, user-defined type.

annotations.description: Ids into the top-level annotations[] registry, attachPoint: "parameter".

members.description: Exactly one of these must be chosen — not zero, not more than one.

ruleMember.description: Exactly one of the three shapes below is populated. additionalProperties is scoped per-branch (not on this object directly) so it doesn't shadow the oneOf.

appliesTo.description: serviceTypes[].id values. Include only when nothing else already links this annotation to a service type.

envelopeType.description: The record being wrapped. Present only when supportedModes includes an includedRecord entry — restating it there too would either duplicate that entry's own "includes" or falsely imply a partial-envelope relationship on a rule with only direct/streamable modes.

cardinality.description: Present when the bound value is an array/batch of the described type — a mode resolves to the array element type, not the param's whole type.

excludes.description: direct only: types in typeConstraint's general category that are explicitly disallowed.

includes.description: includedRecord only: the base record being included via *Type;.

bindableFields.description: includedRecord only: field names the user's record is free to override.
